title: Deepcore
tagline: A turn-based descent through a sinking mining station.
description:
A derelict deep-core mining station is sliding into a gas giant, and its systems have turned hostile. Dive ten procedurally generated decks, scavenge weapons, armor and gadgets, and fight crawlers, drones, sentries, leeches, hulks, swarmers and phasing wraiths — then face the Core Warden and light the escape beacon.

Everything is turn-based and permanent: level up, choose upgrades, trade scrap at fabricators, and see how deep you can get. A shared daily dive gives everyone the same station each day.
controls: Tap a tile to walk there, tap an adjacent enemy to attack. Keyboard: arrows/WASD/numpad/hjklyubn to move and attack, Space or . to wait, > to descend, 1–6 items, F fire, Tab/Enter to target, Esc cancel.

achievements.title: Iron Lungs
